scope: Per-sender UART idle-cutoff envelope semantics, independent of shared airtime arbitration. No proprietary RFD/SiK packetizer claim; installed modem firmware/configuration unread.
failure: Tick previously checked idle completion only when shared air became available. A later UART write while another sender owned air erased the earlier completed idle boundary.
fix: Bounded per-ingress packet length/time descriptors preserve max-burst and idle boundaries while payload retains one existing FIFO owner. Every descriptor owns at least one accepted byte, so descriptor count is bounded by TX FIFO capacity; active bytes remain charged until air completion.

negative.test: Two senders: A owns long airtime; B sends4bytes, idles, then sends4more before A finishes. First B packet must complete without merging later bytes.
negative.old_result: FAIL: busy air erased an already completed UART idle packet boundary

validation.existing_modem_contracts: PASS: finite active TX ownership, RX overflow, byte ordering, detach/reconnect identities, airtime/fairness and trace bounds
validation.production_packetization: PASS192 short probes; worst17.2ms at2ms idle and173.7ms at50ms idle

limitations: Full integrated campaign remains separate and must retain unchanged gates.
This model correction does not establish that physical modem configuration or hardware latency is fixed.
